about_the_game:
Speed drills made fun!

Practice your math facts through several games. These games have been designed to both challenge and improve your mental math skills. Work your way up through an ascending number progression, starting with 1's all the way to 20s in all four foundational arithmetic operations - addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

Progress and Achievement

This app encourages users with advancement and achievement, but all the progress made in-app also means real-life skills are being made. Show off what you've learned with this family-friendly app and improve your mental math skills today!

Leaderboards

Feeling competitive? Strive to reach to top of the global or local leaderboards in your favorite mini-game!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: 1GHz or better: Apple Silicon or x64 Intel
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

name: Mathigo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: 1GHz or better: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

short_description: Mathigo is a casual arcade-style set of minigames where you need to solve math problems to win. Answer addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems to mine gems, tame dragons, catch fish and more! Earn enough points in each minigame to earn stars and unlock new levels.
